g.text: LATCHED = 1 after power-up or any loss of loop current (PRE_N low). Only a RESET edge while PRE_N is high clears it; a held button gives no edge.

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d1d1f

g.text: TX_EN = NOR(FAULT, LATCHED). Inhibit released only with PERMIT AND TX_EN; keying only with KEY AND INH_ON, so keying never coincides with inhibit.

text.style: font-size: 6.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d1d1f

g.text: Unpowered interface: both LEDs off, so INH closed (inhibit) and PTT open. LED ageing errs to the same safe side (F14).
